title: The Quiver's optic is the workshop's scope; hard cores hold 50 to 90 m out where the perch can see them; a 2x lens and a 0.4 s lock
context: Owner: the desired Quiver view is the Sniper workshop's scope (reticle, lock tag, TRACK panel, optic inset); units may be too close, make acquisition further and faster.
outcome: src/fx/story-scope.js draws the workshop's reticle (ring, pip, bracket meter, SEEKING, TARGET LOCKED) as SVG plus a TRACK panel written field by field; the pilot HUD block feeds it from the launcher's own lock. STORY_QUIVER: hold [5, 9] hops, nearCells 12, zoom 2 (applied on both mount paths), maxRange 120 m, lockTime 0.4, aimTolerance 5. The corner monitor shows OPTIC · TARGET, a long lens on the tracked target, when no round flies. First run: the second hard core held 50 m out behind a bend with no sightline, so holdRing now keeps only cells the Quiver's perch can see by the same chord-over-rock test. Controller at 17,609.
alternatives: Height-aware sightlines so a raised mount sees over rock: deferred, the visible ring solves the beat without changing the optic's rules.
evidence: browser --story-world PASS (scope, two kills from two rounds); --dist legacy PASS
